allowed_dependency_manifest.content: For every integer triple n, k, l with 0 <= k <= n and 0 <= l <= n, if the ratio of the Gaussian binomial coefficient for n choose k to the one for n choose l is actually a polynomial in q, then every coefficient of that polynomial is nonnegative.

forbidden_claims.statement_nl: Let [n choose k]_q denote the Gaussian q-binomial coefficient. Prove that for all integers n, k, ℓ with 0 ≤ k, ℓ ≤ n, if [n choose k]_q / [n choose ℓ]_q is a polynomial in q, then it has only nonnegative coefficients.

statement_nl: For integers n, k, and l with 0 <= l <= k <= n/2, define [n choose r]_q := product_{j=1}^r (1 - q^(n-r+j)) / (1 - q^j) for 0 <= r <= n, with the empty product equal to 1 when r = 0. Set m := k-l and d := n-k-l. Then [n choose k]_q / [n choose l]_q = product_{i=1}^m (1 - q^(l+d+i)) / (1 - q^(l+i)), where the product is interpreted as 1 when m = 0.
